description: 園管局產業園區污水處理費現行收費標準 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部產業園區管理局. 1. 為協助產業園區區納廠商污水綜合處理，目前本局所轄產業園區污水處理廠共44處，使區納廠商可申請排放納管，由污水處理廠代為處理廠商廢水。 為維護污水處理廠操作營運，工業區納管廠商需依據污水排放之水量、化學需氧量(COD)及懸浮固體物(SS)繳納污水處理系統使用費，而各產業園區依據污水處理廠規模及系統設置不同，訂定不同之污水處理費。 2.... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部產業園區管理局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
